commitResults.messageTitle: Level 0 completed. Chatbot's name and its greeting was changed.
Completed Level 1. Added functionality to echo whatever user inputs unless its "bye" in which case the bot ends the conversation.
Level 2 completed. Added functionality to add items to list and print list.
Level 3 completed. Added functionality to mark items in the list and edited the UI by changing the print statements.
Level 4 completed. Added specific tasks such as deadline, todo and event with their individual properties and some more edits to the UI.

Level 5 completed. Functionality was added to catch errors such as invalid commands, incorrect formatting such as missing description, missing flags("/by"), improper ordering("/to" before "/from") along with invalid commands like blah and invalid task number when giving the mark command to name a few.
Level 6 completed. Added functionality to delete tasks.

commitResults.messageBody: Add functionality to record tasks in a file to persist across sessions and add precautionary measures against file corruption errors.

commitResults.messageTitle: Level-8: Add data and time formatting Add formatting for data and time to ensure consistency and neat printing
